info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 課程目的在於使學生認識天氣及學習經由氣象圖表的閱讀預測天氣，認識雲圖及了解風的成因。學習閱讀機場天氣報告﹝METAR﹞、天氣預報及天氣提示。認識空氣對流活動的威脅及不穩定氣流的危害。學習利用天文作為導航工具
description.describe_eh: The objective of the courses is to make the weather more understandable, and to assist in helping to create ones own weather forecasts by reading charts, looking at clouds, understanding winds and the workings of the weather. Understand the METAR coding, terminal forecasts and weather advisories. Identify convective weather activity threats. Recognize the danger of instability in atmospheric conditions, Learn the basic navigation technology by means of astronomical observation.
